```{python}
#| title: Publication trend by year
years = studies["publication_year"].value_counts().sort_index()
fig = px.bar(x=years.index, y=years.values)
fig.update_traces(marker_color=ACCENT,
                  hovertemplate="Year %{x}<br>%{y} studies<extra></extra>")
fig.update_layout(xaxis_title="Publication year",
                  yaxis_title="Number of studies",
                  margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig
```

```{python}
#| title: Studies by analysis period

             color=periods.index, color_discrete_sequence=COLOR_SEQ)

                  showlegend=False, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig
```

## Row {height=50%}

```{python}
#| title: "Workflow stage → device → rendering type (Sankey)"
#| classes: mobile-scroll
w = workflow[["record_id", "workflow_stage_label"]]
merged = w.merge(
    studies[["record_id", "device_label", "rendering_type_label"]],
    on="record_id",
).dropna()

links1 = (merged.groupby(["workflow_stage_label", "device_label"])
          .size().reset_index(name="n"))
links2 = (merged.groupby(["device_label", "rendering_type_label"])
          .size().reset_index(name="n"))

stages = sorted(merged["workflow_stage_label"].unique())
devices = sorted(merged["device_label"].unique())
renders = sorted(merged["rendering_type_label"].unique())
nodes = stages + devices + renders
idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(nodes)}
# devices reappear as targets and sources, so offset device index once
dev_idx = {name: len(stages) + i for i, name in enumerate(devices)}
ren_idx = {name: len(stages) + len(devices) + i for i, name in enumerate(renders)}
stage_idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(stages)}

source = ([stage_idx[s] for s in links1["workflow_stage_label"]]
          + [dev_idx[d] for d in links2["device_label"]])
target = ([dev_idx[d] for d in links1["device_label"]]
          + [ren_idx[r] for r in links2["rendering_type_label"]])
value = list(links1["n"]) + list(links2["n"])

palette = (COLOR_SEQ * ((len(nodes) // len(COLOR_SEQ)) + 1))[: len(nodes)]
fig = go.Figure(go.Sankey(
    node=dict(label=nodes, pad=12, thickness=14, color=palette),
    link=dict(source=source, target=target, value=value,
              hovertemplate="%{source.label} → %{target.label}<br>"
                            "%{value} studies<extra></extra>"),
))
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10), font_size=11)
fig
```
